verdict.rationale: Metronome is a billing platform with automated behaviors such as auto-recharge, contract provisioning, webhooks and Stripe invoicing, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows no versioning, review or approval flow, or rollback for any automation or configuration. The closest items are an edit history for seat changes on subscriptions and the ability to archive billable metrics, and neither amounts to versioning or rolling back automations.
